summary: Retest of the 2 issues from iteration 7, plus a quick regression. Both are FIXED. HIGH (client_ip): through the public URL the rate-limit key is now the real client egress IP (ip:34.170.12.145 / new:34.170.12.145), not the shared Google LB (35.244.139.18). Prepending XFF entries or adding X-Real-IP does not change the key. Cloudflare rejects a caller-supplied CF-Connecting-IP with 403, so it cannot be spoofed through the edge. In simulated clients (internal port): different CF-Connecting-IP values, and different XFF[-3] values, get separate counters. CF-Connecting-IP wins over XFF. Entries prepended before XFF[-3] are ignored. Client A at 20 malformed -> 429 while client B -> 422, and A's approved CPF still logs in. Client A at 10 new CPFs -> 429 (user not created) while client B and the public client can still sign up. MEDIUM (Filtros stale enabled): reproduced the exact steps: edit MooveCar min fare (unsaved) -> turn MooveCar ON in Painel -> back to Filtros (unsaved 17 kept, switch shows ON) -> Save. The Save PUT has no 'enabled' key and MooveCar stays LIGADO. The Filtros app-enabled-switch saves at once with PUT {apps:{moove:{enabled:false}}}. Regression passes: CPF 529.982.247-25 login -> Painel, the rapido toggle goes ON then OFF, Filtros per-app save keeps the apps apart (rapido 9 / moove 17), and in the admin UI the pending user moves to Liberados on approve and can then log in. Backend: 23/23 + 6/6 pytest pass. Deprecated packages: none. SafeAreaView issues: none found.

minor.issue: CF-Connecting-IP is trusted unconditionally, and the XFF hop count (-3) is hardcoded for the preview topology (client, Cloudflare, Google LB). If production has no Cloudflare in front, or a different number of hops, callers could set CF-Connecting-IP or rotate XFF and get fresh counters, or all users could share one key again. Make the hop count configurable (e.g. TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS env) and check the production chain once after deploy.

integration_issues.issue: update.mutate() has no onError, so a failed toggle shows no toast and the switch silently stays at the old value. It is also not disabled while pending. Low priority.

action_items: LOW: Make the trusted proxy hop count in client_ip() configurable via env and verify the production X-Forwarded-For / CF-Connecting-IP chain after deploy.
LOW: Add onError toast handling to the Filtros app-enabled-switch mutation, and disable it while update.isPending.
LOW (cleanup): AppForm.enabled in filtros.tsx is now unused for saving and could be removed. The switches (Painel/Filtros) do not expose aria-checked on web; a11y only.
critical_code_review_comments: client_ip() is correct for the preview ingress. It depends on Cloudflare being the only entry point.
filtros.tsx save() no longer sends apps.*.enabled. The switch reads settings.data (updated via setQueryData) instead of the possibly stale form.
